ryans.name: Ryan Leonard
ryans.title: Right wing for the Washington Capitals; 2023 first-round pick and former Boston College star
ryans.photo_credit: Sandro Halank, Wikimedia Commons (cropped and resized)
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Leonard** (born January 21, 2005) is an American professional ice hockey right winger for the Washington Capitals of the National Hockey League (NHL) [4]. The Capitals chose him eighth overall in the 2023 NHL Draft [1]. He played two seasons at Boston College, where he led the nation in goals as a sophomore and was named Hockey East Player of the Year [1][2]. He captained the United States to the 2025 World Junior Championship gold medal and was named the tournament's most valuable player [1].
known_for: 8th overall pick, 2023 NHL Draft
Hockey East Player of the Year and nation's goals leader, 2024–25
Captain and MVP of the U.S. team at the 2025 World Juniors
45 points as a rookie for Washington, 2025–26

ryans.name: Ryan Day
ryans.title: Head football coach at The Ohio State University
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Patrick Day** (born March 12, 1979) is an American college and professional football coach and former collegiate quarterback who serves as the head football coach at The Ohio State University [1][2][4]. Named to succeed Urban Meyer on December 4, 2018, after going 3–0 as acting head coach at the start of the 2018 season, Day officially took over as Ohio State's head coach on January 2, 2019 [1][2][3].
known_for: Head football coach at Ohio State University (2019–present)
Winning the 2024 College Football Playoff National Championship
2019 Big Ten Coach of the Year and five CFP appearances
Childhood and adolescent mental health advocacy with On Our Sleeves

ryans.name: Ryan Poles
ryans.title: General Manager of the Chicago Bears
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan C. Poles** (born September 20, 1985) is an American professional football executive and former collegiate offensive lineman who serves as the general manager of the Chicago Bears of the National Football League (NFL) [1][2][9]. Named the seventh general manager in franchise history on January 25, 2022, at age 36, Poles previously spent 13 seasons (2009–2021) in the front office of the Kansas City Chiefs, rising from player personnel assistant to executive director of player personnel [1][2].
known_for: Seventh general manager in Chicago Bears franchise history (2022–present)
2023 No. 1 draft pick trade with Carolina Panthers that yielded DJ Moore and Caleb Williams
Executive Director of Player Personnel for the Kansas City Chiefs (Super Bowl LIV champion)
2025 NFC North division championship with head coach Ben Johnson

ryans.name: Ryan Reynolds
ryans.title: Actor and businessman
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Rodney Reynolds** (born October 23, 1976) is a Canadian-American actor, producer, and entrepreneur. He is best known for starring as the Marvel antihero Deadpool, and for building consumer brands and a Welsh football club alongside film work [1][2][3].
known_for: Deadpool franchise
Aviation Gin
Mint Mobile
Wrexham AFC

ryans.name: Ryan Smith
ryans.title: Qualtrics founder; Utah Jazz and Mammoth owner
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Smith** (born June 28, 1978) is an American businessman, the co-founder and executive chairman of experience-management software company **Qualtrics**, and the owner of the NBA’s **Utah Jazz** and NHL’s **Utah Mammoth** through Smith Entertainment Group [1][7][8][9].
known_for: Co-founding Qualtrics
SAP's $8B Qualtrics acquisition
Owning the Utah Jazz and Utah Mammoth
